'''Red Squadron 4''' was a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fighter was part of [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], piloted by [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]]. At the time of the battle, the fighter had the second highest mission total of any X-wing in active service.<ref name="CCG-Red4" />
